_note: Neutral template that matches targets.example.json and ecosystems.example.json. Copy it to profiles.json and edit. A profile selects targets by workflow ('workflows') or by exact name ('names'), optionally limited to some ecosystems ('ecosystems'); build-only targets are never selected. canary true = the first target goes alone and the rest only follow if it is green. Keys that start with _ are ignored.

release.description: Every signed target of your main ecosystem. The first one goes alone; the rest only if it is green.

firmware-only.description: One target chosen by name, no canary.

hil.description: The targets that talk to hardware in the loop (a firmware repository and its bench bridge). Replace the names with your own.
